description: This file contains shell script functions for setting up, tearing down, and configuring IPv6 464xlat CLAT protocol on a network device. It includes functions for network configuration, firewall rules, and routing specific to 464xlat.

methods.name: proto_464xlat_setup
methods.description: Sets up the 464xlat CLAT protocol by configuring IP addresses, routing, and firewall rules based on provided configuration variables.

methods.name: proto_464xlat_teardown
methods.description: Tears down the 464xlat CLAT configuration, removing rules and cleaning up temporary files.

methods.name: proto_464xlat_init_config
methods.description: Initializes the configuration options for the 464xlat protocol.
